name: Chena
source:
Race: Female human
Origin: Guardian City, Ruaza
Hobby: Singing, Dancing
Job: Archer

An orphan who lives in Dark Kingdom, Chena is a master of archery and a lover of singing and dancing. A sweet and shy girl, but can be very scary when provoked. 

First appeared in Zeiva's early game series - Genetic Glow.
